concerns.text: SC-001 requires a decision rule: if permutation p < 0.05, report ΔR² + 95% CI AND classify as 'statistically significant and practically meaningful improvement' (ΔR² > 0.05) vs 'statistically significant but below practical threshold' (ΔR² ≤ 0.05). T018 computes the CI and T013's final_report lists model_summary fields, but no task implements the SC-001 classification/verdict output. Add a task (or extend T013) that emits this classification.

concerns.location: tasks.md (all phases) vs data-model.md:Data Hygiene & Provenance
concerns.text: The data model requires (a) checksums recorded in data/raw/checksums.yaml, (b) derived files with content-hashed filenames (e.g., aligned_20241015_abcdef.parquet), and (c) a provenance block (source_file, script, git_commit, timestamp) in each artifact JSON. No task produces any of these three elements. T004 provides a sha256_checksum() utility but no task applies it to record data/raw/checksums.yaml or provenance blocks.

concerns.location: tasks.md (all phases) vs spec.md:Edge Cases (instrument versions)
concerns.text: The spec's third edge case (ACE SWICS vs SWICS-2 transitions: documented calibration offsets or cohort separation) has no implementing task anywhere in tasks.md. Either add a task or document why it is out of scope for the synthetic-data path.

Plan Phase 8/9 and the data model specify a single permutation_results.json consumed by sensitivity.py, but T011 emits three separate files (permutation_o_fe.json, permutation_he_h.json, permutation_c_o.json) and T012 reads from an unspecified source. The plan's file contract has no matching task; either add a task that consolidates the three files into permutation_results.json or reconcile the plan.

Plan Phase 10 says main.py aggregates results into 'final tables & plots in data/artifacts/'; no task produces any plot or table artifact beyond JSON/CSV files. If plots are dropped, this is a plan/tasks mismatch to reconcile; otherwise add a reporting task.
